explanation: Relink each BST into an inorder doubly linked list, merge the sorted lists, and consume the merged list in inorder to form a balanced BST. Original nodes supply the result rather than allocating replacement tree nodes.
spaceComplexity: O(hA+hB+log(m+n+1)) recursion space, excluding the reused tree nodes.
